progression.narrative: The performance opens on E3 and dwells most on A in Bayat Raje. The line peaks at B4 (502.4 Hz) at 0:44.2. It closes on Fs4, not the tonic (A4 → Ab4 → Ab4 → Fs4 → Fs4 → Fs4).
